A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BOA study. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable, and retained content can be matched across renumbering and relocation.

before.justification: Sections 4.2–4.3 and Appendix C report original quantization experiments, including perplexity, zero-shot accuracy, and processing times.

after.justification: V3 retains the original quantization experiments in the main text and Appendix D, and adds memory measurements and results for Relaxed BOA.

M1.justification: V3 introduces Relaxed BOA, which uses the standard Hessian for value projections while retaining attention-aware query/key Hessians (Section 4.2). Section 3.3 also specifies RoPE-aware Hessians, but the PDFs do not establish whether these were newly implemented for the unchanged benchmark results.

E1.justification: WikiText-2 and the same eight zero-shot reasoning tasks are retained. The added memory comparison uses existing model sizes and task coverage; no new dataset, domain, or input scenario is evaluated.

E2.justification: V2 Table 5 compares BOA's processing time with OmniQuant, AffineQuant, and DuQuant + LWC; v3 Table 5 adds GPTQ to that comparison. Benchmark accuracy comparators remain unchanged. Newly cited QuIP# and AQLM are explicitly excluded from evaluation.

E3.justification: V3 adds memory cost in GB as an evaluation measure in Table 4; existing calibration sizes, benchmark metrics, and quantization configurations are retained. Its new activation-only SpinQuant training description in Section 4.3 conflicts with Appendix D.3's retained weight-and-activation setting for SpinQuant-RTN, so an actual switch in that setting is unresolved.

E4.justification: V3 Table 4 adds an ablation replacing the attention-aware value Hessian with the standard Hessian, testing memory versus perplexity on 7B, 13B, and 30B models. The existing ablation of simultaneous head quantization in Table 2 is unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests. V3's newly disclosed comparisons with and without the ordering heuristic are configuration comparisons, not uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Existing benchmark accuracy and perplexity entries are unchanged. V3 adds memory measurements and Relaxed BOA results: Table 4 reports 11.55 GB and 7.007 PPL at 30B, versus full BOA's 32.79 GB and 6.669 PPL. Table 5 adds GPTQ times of 0.12, 0.20, and 0.43 hours; other timing differences are equivalent rounding.

T1.justification: New Appendix B derives RoPE-dependent query/key Hessians using a tokenwise sum of Kronecker products and an additional factorization approximation, supporting Equations 13–15. This substantially extends the core mathematical treatment to position-dependent attention absent from v2. The generic Hessian and row-update proofs are retained.

C1.justification: Both versions claim backpropagation-free weight optimization that accounts for inter-layer dependencies through attention-aware Hessians, improved low-bit quantization, and synergy with transformation methods. The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain this scientific scope.

C2.justification: V3 expands the overhead discussion into explicit memory and speed versus accuracy tradeoffs relative to GPTQ. Section 4.2 attributes these costs to value-projection Hessians and sequential row updates, discusses the lower-memory variant, and identifies additional within-head parallelization as future work.

D1.justification: V3 newly discloses reporting the better GPTQ/BOA results obtained with and without Hessian-diagonal ordering, specifies dynamic per-token Min-Max activation quantization, and supplies a planned code-release location. These disclosures do not establish reruns or current code availability; calibration and hardware information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: V3 adds references supporting QAT/PTQ context, RoPE, and Kronecker factorization, plus QuIP# and AQLM with a codebook-memory rationale for exclusion. The AWQ citation is removed. BOA's central positioning relative to GPTQ and transformation-based quantization remains intact.

P1.justification: V3 makes localized rewrites to the abstract, experimental setup, and discussion, frequently replacing 'integer weights' with 'quantized weights.' It inserts the RoPE appendix, reletters subsequent appendices, and adds acknowledgments and conference/equal-contribution information while retaining the main narrative structure.

P2.justification: V3 adds the memory table and expands the timing table with GPTQ and an inter-layer-dependency column. Table 1 gains a RoPE footnote, Table 2 gains clearer model headings, and Figure 2 moves within the retained proof. Existing figures and benchmark table structures otherwise remain substantially unchanged.

improvement.justification: V3 improves technical completeness through the RoPE derivation and implementation disclosures, while the new memory ablation and GPTQ timing comparison make resource tradeoffs clearer. Existing benchmark results remain unchanged. These gains are tempered by the new Section 4.3 activation-only SpinQuant statement, which omits the SpinQuant-RTN exception retained in Appendix D.3.
